chunks: Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Ishaq (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id al-Kufi informed us. He said: Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Faddal narrated to us from his father, from Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Musa al-Rida, from his father Musa ibn Ja'far, from his father Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father Muhammad ibn Ali, from his father Ali ibn al-Husayn, from his father al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon them all). He said:

When death came to al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him), he wept. It was said to him: O son of the Messenger of God, do you weep when you hold such a position with the Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family), and you have performed Hajj twenty times on foot, and you have divided your wealth with your Lord three times -- even to the sandals? He (peace be upon him) said: I weep only for two reasons: the horror of the overlooking [of the Hereafter], and separation from loved ones.

key_terms.فراق الأحبة: Firaq al-Ahibba - separation from loved ones; the sorrow of leaving behind those one loves
key_terms.هول المطلع: Hawl al-Muttala' - the horror/terror of the overlooking; the awesome moment of transitioning to the Hereafter

ai.seo_question: Why did Imam al-Hasan weep at the time of death?
ai.summary: Through a golden chain of Imams going back to Imam al-Husayn, this hadith narrates the final moments of Imam al-Hasan ibn Ali. Despite his immense piety -- having performed Hajj twenty times on foot and given away his entire wealth three times -- the Imam wept at the approach of death. When asked why, he explained that he wept for only two reasons: the awesome terror of what lies ahead in the Hereafter, and the pain of parting from his loved ones. This teaching shows that even the most pious individuals approach death with humility and awe.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Ibrahim b. Ishaq (ra) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Sa`id al-Kufi informed us. He said: `Ali b. al-Husayn b. `Ali b. Faddal narrated to us from his father from Abi’l Hasan `Ali b. Musa al-Rida from his father Musa b. Ja`far from his father Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father Muhammad b. `Ali from his father `Ali b. al-Husayn from his father al-Husayn b. `Ali (as).  He said:

When death attended to al-Hasan b. `Ali b. Abi Talib (as), he wept. It was said to him: O son of the Messenger of Allah! Why do you weep when you have such a position with the Messenger of Allah (s); and after all that the Messenger of Allah (s) had said about you? You have performed Hajj twenty times on foot and given all your belongings to the needy three times! So, he said: I weep for two reasons: (1) The horror of resurrection, and (2) separation from my loved ones.
